item.title: Cordae & Jonquel Jones Open Up About Therapy, Pressure & Finding Balance
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Like Minded by BetterHelp. Today, we're in Brooklyn, New York, with an incredible conversation between two high-performing individuals: New York Liberty star Jonquel Jones and rapper Cordae. They're joining us to talk about the mental side of high performance and how they stay grounded amidst the pressure and spotlight.
[Soft music transitions]
Host: Jonquel and Cordae are opening up about their experiences with therapy and what helps them build resilience. Jonquel shares, "Sometimes there are things that get a little bigger than what I can control myself, and that's when I go into therapy. I'm a big advocate for it."
[Cordae's voice is heard]
Host: Cordae also shares his perspective, "I started therapy because I got trust issues and I didn't want to trauma dump on people." He even jokes about having "rich people problems."
[Soft music continues]
Host: It's a raw and honest conversation about navigating the highs and lows of their careers and personal lives. Join us as we dive deeper into their stories and explore what it takes to find balance, resilience, and authenticity – both on and off the stage.
[Outro music starts]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to this episode of Like Minded by BetterHelp. Stay tuned for more conversations about mental health and wellness.
[Outro music continues to play]
